import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

# Configuration
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
OUTPUT_DIR = "./submission"
os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv"))
test_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv"))

# Feature Engineering: Character n-gram TF-IDF captures syntactic and morphological style markers
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char_wb",
    ngram_range=(2, 5),
    sublinear_tf=True,
    max_features=30000,
    min_df=2,
)

X_train_full = vectorizer.fit_transform(train_df["text"])
X_test = vectorizer.transform(test_df["text"])
y_train = train_df["author"]

# Stratified Hold-Out Validation (Strictly prevents data leakage)
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Train validator exclusively on the training fold
val_model = LogisticRegression(
    C=1.0,
    max_iter=1000,
    solver="lbfgs",
    multi_class="multinomial",
    class_weight="balanced",
)
val_model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)

# Evaluate on unseen validation set
val_probs = val_model.predict_proba(X_val)
val_logloss = log_loss(y_val, val_probs, labels=val_model.classes_)
print(f"Validation Multi-class Log-Loss: {val_logloss:.6f}")

# Train final model on the entire training distribution
final_model = LogisticRegression(
    C=1.0,
    max_iter=1000,
    solver="lbfgs",
    multi_class="multinomial",
    class_weight="balanced",
)
final_model.fit(X_train_full, y_train)

# Generate and format test predictions
test_probs = final_model.predict_proba(X_test)
target_classes = ["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]
submission = pd.DataFrame(test_probs, columns=final_model.classes_)
submission = submission[target_classes]  # Enforce exact column order
submission.insert(0, "id", test_df["id"])
submission.to_csv(os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "submission.csv"), index=False)
print("Submission saved successfully to ./submission/submission.csv")
